title: Foundry agent + toolbox eval turn
description: One JSON object per line of a data/agent-evals/*.jsonl file. Turns that share a conversation_id run in turn_number order as one conversation. Validate with scripts/validate_eval_jsonl.py, which also flags settings the pass_criteria ignores, duplicate turns, and turn-number gaps.

expected_tool_calls.description: Calls the agent must make in this turn (other calls are allowed unless listed in must_not_call). Checked when pass_criteria is tool_called_correctly or both.

ordered.description: expected_tool_calls must occur in this order

must_not_call.description: Tools that must not be called in this turn. Always enforced.

expected_response_pattern.description: Case-insensitive Python regex the final reply must match. Required when pass_criteria is response_matches or both.

response_must_not_match.description: Case-insensitive Python regex the final reply must not match. Always enforced.

params.description: Arguments the call must include (others may be present). Strings compare case-insensitively; prefix a string with re: for a case-insensitive regex search.
